svg.title: InspectRT cross-platform latency and nearest-neighbour index comparison
svg.desc: Panel A shows p50 to p95 pipeline stage latency for five timing-valid environments. Panel B shows exact top-1 nearest-neighbour index differences for five completed candidates, including MPS.

g.text: Share of 84,992 patch queries selecting a different
memory-bank row than the T1000 reference
All floating outputs and metrics remained within the reviewed policy.
Same frozen workload. Five warm-ups and 30 measured repeats. MPS latency was not collected.
